basic_details.job_title: Bharathiar University Public Relations Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Bharathiar University, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, has invited applications for the post of Public Relations Officer under Advt No. BU/Estt./E5/2026/PRO/16943. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Shall not exceed 42 years and 47 years for SC/ST (on the date of notification)

qualification.education_qualification: As prescribed by the Syndicate of Bharathiar University.
qualification.details: Qualification: Good academic record plus Master’s Degree with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven-point scale Desirable: Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Development or Diploma in Mass Communication / Public Relations of a recognized University / Institution. Age limit: Shall not exceed 42 years and 47 years for SC/ST (on the date of notification) Age relaxation: SC/ST 47

how_to_apply: Applications are submitted offline and must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026. The application format and the address are given in the official notification.
